title: Sanctus (version II) (Josquin, Missa Ad fugam)
desc: Josquin des Prez, Missa Ad fugam, Sanctus (version II). 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Jos1201d.b); encoded by Jesse Rodin. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
